fns.doc: Sets a float property.

fns.name: set_texture
fns.doc: Sets a texture property, _MainTex by default.

fns.name: info
fns.doc: Shader, colour and texture of a material.

fns.name: destroy
fns.doc: Frees a material.

fns.name: load_bundle
fns.doc: Loads an asset bundle from the mod folder and registers its shaders. Returns their names.

fns.name: fleck
fns.doc: Spawns a fleck, a short visual effect, on a cell.

fns.name: text
fns.doc: Floats a line of text up from a cell.

fns.name: effecter
fns.doc: Plays an effecter once at a cell.

fns.name: highlight_cells
fns.doc: Outlines a set of cells. Returns an overlay id.

fns.name: line
fns.doc: Draws a line between two cells.

fns.name: circle
fns.doc: Draws a circle outline.

fns.name: mark
fns.doc: Highlights a thing with the selection bracket.

fns.name: screen_shake
fns.doc: Shakes the camera, 0 to 2.

fns.name: clear
fns.doc: Removes one overlay, or all of them. Returns how many.

fns.name: fleck_defs
fns.doc: Fleck defs.

fns.name: effecter_defs
fns.doc: Effecter defs.

fns.name: register_key
fns.doc: Makes a key binding the player can rebind in the options. Read it with game.input.binding_just_pressed.

fns.name: key_down
fns.doc: Whether a key is held. Keys are Unity key names such as K, F9, LeftArrow.

fns.name: key_pressed
fns.doc: Whether a key went down this frame.

fns.name: chord_pressed
fns.doc: A modifier chord such as ctrl+shift+K, true on the frame the key goes down.

fns.name: modifiers
fns.doc: Which of ctrl, shift and alt are held.

fns.name: mouse
fns.doc: Mouse position, buttons, scroll and the map cell under it.

fns.name: key_names
fns.doc: Every key name.

fns.name: bindings
fns.doc: Every key binding with its current key.

fns.name: define
fns.doc: Defines a sound from clips in a mod's Sounds folder (paths without extension). Play it with game.audio.play.

fns.name: sound_defs
fns.doc: Every sound def.

fns.name: songs
fns.doc: Every song def.

fns.name: play_song
fns.doc: Starts a song now.

fns.name: silence_music
fns.doc: Silences the music for a while.

fns.name: volume
fns.doc: Volume of game, music or ambient sound, 0 to 1.

fns.name: set_volume
fns.doc: Sets a volume and saves the preference.

fns.name: sustainer_end
fns.doc: Stops a sustained sound.

fns.name: play_at
fns.doc: Plays a sound at a cell, louder when the camera is near.

fns.name: sustainer_start
fns.doc: Starts a looping sound at a cell. Returns an id for sustainer_end.

fns.name: add
fns.doc: Adds an alert to the right edge. The check function runs regularly and returns true, false or { active, label, explanation, culprits }.

fns.name: remove
fns.doc: Stops an alert from being active.

fns.name: list
fns.doc: Lua alerts.

fns.name: status
fns.doc: Shows a line of text in a corner of the screen. Calling it again with the same id updates it. Corner is top_left, top_right or bottom_left.

fns.name: clear_status
fns.doc: Removes a status line.

fns.name: letter
fns.doc: Sends a letter with answer buttons. Answers raise the letter.choice event with the tag, index and label, and survive saving.

fns.name: colors
fns.doc: The colour presets, name to #rrggbb. Names such as accent, good, warning, bad, muted work wherever a color is accepted.

fns.name: set_color
fns.doc: Defines or changes a colour preset.

fns.name: set_font
fns.doc: Default font for widgets: tiny, small or medium.

fns.name: page

params.name: on_change
params.type: fun(change: { package_id: string, key: string, value: any })

fns.doc: Adds a page to RimKit's entry in the mod settings. Values are stored with the settings and read with game.config.get or game.options.get.

fns.name: remove_page
fns.doc: Removes the settings pages a mod added. The stored values are kept.

fns.name: get
fns.doc: Reads an option by key.

fns.name: set
fns.doc: Changes an option.

fns.name: pages
fns.doc: Registered pages.

fns.name: things
fns.doc: Things on a map matching the filters, in one host call.

fns.name: pawns
fns.doc: Pawns matching the filters, on one map or all maps.

fns.name: count_by_def
fns.doc: Total count per thing def, stacks included.

fns.name: radius
fns.doc: Things within a radius of a cell.

fns.name: nearest
fns.doc: The closest spawned thing to a cell.

fns.name: generate
fns.doc: Generates a pawn with the game's own generator, and spawns it when map, x and z are given.

fns.name: kinds
fns.doc: Every pawn kind def.

fns.name: thing_set
fns.doc: Generates the items a thing set maker would (rewards, trade goods) without placing them.

fns.name: thing_set_defs
fns.doc: Every thing set maker def name.

fns.name: stuff_options
fns.doc: Materials a thing def can be made from.

fns.name: random_stuff
fns.doc: A random material for a thing def.

fns.name: roll_quality
fns.doc: Rolls a quality the way the game does. Generator: Reward, BaseGen, Gift, OnMap or Trader.

fns.name: pawns
fns.doc: The selected pawns.

fns.name: zones
fns.doc: The selected zones.

fns.name: count
fns.doc: How many objects are selected.

fns.name: select
fns.doc: Selects only this thing.

fns.name: add
fns.doc: Adds a thing to the selection.

fns.name: clear
fns.doc: Clears the selection.

fns.name: inspected
fns.doc: The single selected object, nil when nothing or several are selected.

fns.name: jump_cell
fns.doc: Moves the camera to a cell.

fns.name: jump_thing
fns.doc: Moves the camera to a thing, switching maps when needed.

fns.name: position
fns.doc: Where the camera looks and how far it is zoomed.

fns.name: mouse_cell
fns.doc: The cell under the mouse pointer.

fns.name: interact
fns.doc: Makes the pawn start a social interaction such as Chitchat or Insult. False when it could not.

fns.name: interaction_defs
fns.doc: Every interaction def name.

fns.name: opinion_reasons
fns.doc: The pawn's opinion of another pawn with each reason and its offset.

fns.name: partner
fns.doc: Spouse, fiance or lover.

fns.name: marry
fns.doc: Makes the two pawns spouses, removing lover and fiance relations.

fns.name: break_up
fns.doc: Ends a romantic relation and records an ex-lover. False when there was none.

fns.name: animal_info
fns.doc: Trainability, wildness, master, bond and training state. Raises RK3003 for a non-animal.

fns.name: set_master
fns.doc: Sets the animal's master, or clears it when nil.

fns.name: train
fns.doc: Teaches a trainable such as Obedience or Release. False when it cannot learn it.

fns.name: tame
fns.doc: Makes a wild animal join the player.

fns.name: guest_info
fns.doc: Guest, prisoner or slave data.

fns.name: set_guest_status
fns.doc: Sets Guest, Prisoner or Slave for the player.

fns.name: set_interaction_mode
fns.doc: Sets the prisoner interaction mode, for example ReduceResistance or Convert.

fns.name: interaction_modes
fns.doc: Every prisoner interaction mode def name.

fns.name: recruit
fns.doc: Recruits a prisoner or guest into the colony.

fns.name: info

fns.name: defs

fns.name: threat_points
fns.doc: Threat points for a map, the current map by default.

fns.name: difficulty

fns.name: set_difficulty
fns.doc: Changes one difficulty setting, for example threatScale.

fns.name: defs
fns.doc: Every incident def with category and chance.

fns.name: can_fire
fns.doc: Whether the game would let the incident fire now.

fns.name: fire
fns.doc: Fires an incident with options on a map (the current map by default).

fns.name: queue
fns.doc: Queues an incident to fire after some ticks.

fns.name: list
fns.doc: Every quest, optionally only those in one state.

fns.name: defs
fns.doc: Every quest script def name.

fns.name: generate
fns.doc: Generates a quest from a script and makes it available.

fns.name: accept
fns.doc: Accepts a quest offer.

fns.name: finish
fns.doc: Ends a quest with Success, Fail, InvalidPreAcceptance or Unknown. Returns the new state.

fns.name: signal
fns.doc: Sends a quest signal that quest parts listen for.

fns.name: slate_get
fns.doc: A value of the quest slate while a Lua quest node runs, such as points, map, asker or any value an earlier node stored. nil when it is not set.

fns.name: slate_set

fns.name: slate_set_object
fns.doc: Stores a game object (a pawn, thing, map or faction) in the quest slate.

fns.name: list
fns.doc: All projects, or only finished, available or locked ones.

fns.name: info
fns.doc: One project.

fns.name: current
fns.doc: The project being researched.

fns.name: set_current
fns.doc: Starts researching a project.

fns.name: finish
fns.doc: Completes a project at once, with the game's letter.

fns.name: set_progress
fns.doc: Sets the progress of a project, clamped to its cost.

fns.name: knowledge
fns.doc: Anomaly knowledge. Adds points to a category (Basic or Advanced) when asked.

fns.name: value
fns.doc: The final value of a stat for a thing, nil when the stat is disabled for it.

fns.name: explain
fns.doc: The value with the game's own explanation of where it comes from.

fns.name: defs
fns.doc: Every stat def, optionally one category.

fns.name: verbs
fns.doc: Attacks a pawn or weapon can make: range, burst, damage, melee or ranged.

fns.name: attack
fns.doc: Orders a pawn to attack a target with its best verb.

fns.name: armor
fns.doc: Armor rating against sharp, blunt and heat damage.

fns.name: turret_info
fns.doc: Target and state of a turret.

fns.name: turret_target
fns.doc: Orders a gun turret to attack a target, or clears the order when nil.

fns.name: explode
fns.doc: Causes an explosion.

fns.name: start_fire
fns.doc: Starts a fire on a cell.

fns.name: extinguish
fns.doc: Puts out the fires on a cell. Returns how many.

fns.name: fires
fns.doc: Every fire on the map.

fns.name: launch
fns.doc: Launches a projectile def from one cell to another.

fns.name: damage_defs
fns.doc: Every damage def.

fns.name: projectile_defs
fns.doc: Every projectile def with damage and speed.

fns.name: can_place
fns.doc: Whether a building can be planned there, and why not.

fns.name: blueprint
fns.doc: Plans a building. Colonists build it.

fns.name: blueprints
fns.doc: Planned buildings.

fns.name: frames
fns.doc: Buildings under construction with their progress.

fns.name: instant
fns.doc: Builds a finished building at once.

fns.name: cancel
fns.doc: Cancels a blueprint or frame.

fns.name: defs
fns.doc: Buildings a player can build, optionally one architect category.

fns.name: net
fns.doc: Power state of a building and its whole power net.

fns.name: set_battery
fns.doc: Sets a battery's charge from 0 to 1.

fns.name: list
fns.doc: The bills on a workbench.

fns.name: add
fns.doc: Adds a bill. Returns its index.

fns.name: remove
fns.doc: Deletes a bill by index.

fns.name: suspend
fns.doc: Suspends or resumes a bill.

fns.name: recipes
fns.doc: What a workbench can make.

fns.name: info
fns.doc: State of a door.

fns.name: hold_open
fns.doc: Holds a door open.

fns.name: info
fns.doc: Whether a trap is armed.

fns.name: silver
fns.doc: Silver the colony holds on a map, the current map by default.

fns.name: wealth
fns.doc: Colony wealth split into items, buildings, pawns and floors.

fns.name: price
fns.doc: Market value of a def (with a material) or a thing, with rough trade prices.

fns.name: give_silver
fns.doc: Drops silver by pod next to the colony.

fns.name: trader_kinds
fns.doc: Every trader kind def.

fns.name: ships
fns.doc: Passing ships and orbital traders.

fns.name: stock
fns.doc: Goods of a settlement, or of an orbital trader by index.

fns.name: call_trader
fns.doc: Calls an orbital trader.

fns.name: strategies
fns.doc: Every raid strategy def.

fns.name: arrival_modes
fns.doc: Every way a raid can arrive.

fns.name: can_fire
fns.doc: Whether a raid with these options could fire now.

fns.name: fire
fns.doc: Sends a raid at a map.

fns.name: info
fns.doc: Everything about a thing in one call.

fns.name: quality
fns.doc: Awful to Legendary, nil when the thing has no quality.

fns.name: set_quality
fns.doc: Accepts a name (any case) or 0 to 6. Raises RK3003 when the thing has no quality.

fns.name: stuff
fns.doc: The material def name.

fns.name: forbidden
fns.doc: Whether the thing is forbidden for the player.

fns.name: set_forbidden
fns.doc: Forbids or allows the thing. It must be spawned.

fns.name: rotation
fns.doc: 0 north, 1 east, 2 south, 3 west.

fns.name: set_rotation
fns.doc: Sets the rotation, 0 to 3.

fns.name: comps
fns.doc: Class names of the comps, for example CompQuality.

fns.name: has_comp
fns.doc: Whether the thing has a comp of this class, with or without the Comp prefix.

fns.name: damage
fns.doc: Deals damage. Damage def defaults to Cut. Returns hit points left.

fns.name: heal
fns.doc: Restores hit points to the maximum. Not for pawns.

fns.name: destroy_with
fns.doc: Destroys with a mode: Vanish, Deconstruct, KillFinalize, Refund, Cancel or FailConstruction.

fns.name: make
fns.doc: Creates a thing without placing it.

fns.name: spawn_at
fns.doc: Creates a thing and puts it on the map.

fns.name: minify
fns.doc: Turns a minifiable building into a minified item in place. Returns the minified thing.

fns.name: inner
fns.doc: The thing inside a minified item.

fns.name: style
fns.doc: The style def name of the thing.

fns.name: set_style
fns.doc: Sets the style by def name, or clears it when nil.

fns.name: owners

fns.name: assign_owner
fns.doc: Assigns a pawn to a bed or other assignable thing.

fns.name: unassign_owner
fns.doc: Removes an assignment.

fns.name: storage_allows
fns.doc: Whether a storage building or stockpile accepts a thing def.

fns.name: storage_set_allowed
fns.doc: Changes what a storage building accepts.

fns.name: storage_priority
fns.doc: Unstored, Low, Normal, Preferred, Important or Critical.

fns.name: set_storage_priority
fns.doc: Sets the storage priority.

fns.doc: Removes a temporary faction. Raises RK1001 for any other faction.

fns.name: make_peace
fns.doc: Sets the relation with the player to Neutral, with the game's letter. Returns the relation.

fns.name: declare_war
fns.doc: Sets the relation with the player to Hostile.

fns.name: send_gift
fns.doc: Consumes the items and raises goodwill by market value / 40, at most 40. Returns the new goodwill.

fns.name: make_temporary
fns.doc: Generates a temporary faction from a faction def, for quests and events.

fns.name: now
fns.doc: Calendar fields for the current map. Raises RK3001 when no game is loaded.

fns.name: speed
fns.doc: Current game speed: Paused, Normal, Fast, Superfast or Ultrafast.

fns.name: set_speed
fns.doc: Sets the speed. Accepts a name (any case) or 0 to 4. Returns the speed that was set.

fns.name: paused
fns.doc: Whether the game is paused.

fns.name: set_paused
fns.doc: Pauses or unpauses. Returns the state after the call.

fns.name: date_text
fns.doc: Readable date such as "5th of Aprimay, 5500". Without an argument it uses now.

fns.name: open

fns.name: close
fns.doc: Closes a window.

fns.name: set_state
fns.doc: Sets the value of an input widget by its id.

fns.name: state
fns.doc: The current values of the input widgets of a window.

fns.name: invalidate
fns.doc: Makes the window call its view function on the next frame.

fns.name: windows
fns.doc: Open Lua windows.

fns.name: confirm
fns.doc: A yes or no dialog.

fns.name: prompt
fns.doc: A text input dialog.

fns.name: add_toggle
fns.doc: Adds a toggle button.

fns.name: add_slider
fns.doc: Adds a slider.

fns.name: remove
fns.doc: Removes a gizmo.

fns.name: list
fns.doc: Lua gizmos.

fns.name: add_main
fns.doc: Adds a button to the main tab bar at the bottom of the screen, opening a widget view.

fns.name: add_inspect
fns.doc: Adds an inspect tab next to Health and Needs for the defs or target in opts.

fns.name: pawn_tables
fns.doc: Pawn table def names.

fns.name: architect_categories
fns.doc: Architect category def names.

fns.name: add
fns.doc: Defines a click or drag tool. can_designate returns true, false or the reason it is not allowed. For thing tools the callbacks receive the thing.

fns.name: add_to_architect
fns.doc: Puts a tool in an architect category.

fns.name: remove
fns.doc: Removes a tool and takes it out of the architect menu.

fns.name: activate
fns.doc: Selects the tool as if the player clicked its button.

fns.name: list
fns.doc: Lua tools.

fns.name: create
fns.doc: Makes an allowed area. False when one with the label exists.

fns.name: set
fns.doc: Adds or removes a cell in an area.

fns.name: cells
fns.doc: The cells of an area, at most 2000.

fns.name: remove
fns.doc: Deletes an area.

fns.name: info
fns.doc: Size, seed and object counts of the world.

fns.name: tile_info
fns.doc: Biome, terrain, climate and what sits on a tile.

fns.name: distance
fns.doc: Approximate distance in tiles between two tiles.

fns.name: settlements
fns.doc: Settlements, optionally of one faction.

fns.name: objects
fns.doc: Every world object, optionally one def.

fns.name: create_object
fns.doc: Places a world object on a tile.

fns.name: caravans
fns.doc: Every caravan.

fns.name: pawns
fns.doc: Living pawns that are not on a map.

fns.name: map_at
fns.doc: The loaded map on a tile.

fns.name: generate_map
fns.doc: Generates the map for a tile and returns it. Slow.

fns.name: biomes
fns.doc: Every biome def.

fns.name: find_tile
fns.doc: The nearest tile that matches the search.

fns.name: object_info
fns.doc: Details of a world object.

fns.name: remove_object
fns.doc: Removes a world object that has no loaded map.

fns.name: travel
fns.doc: Sends a caravan to a tile.

fns.name: terrains
fns.doc: Every terrain def with fertility and path cost.

fns.name: map_generators
fns.doc: Every map generator def name.

fns.name: map_steps
fns.doc: Map generation steps, in order, optionally of one generator.

fns.name: world_steps
fns.doc: World generation steps.

fns.name: features
fns.doc: Named world features (mountain ranges, seas).

fns.name: rivers
fns.doc: Every river def.

fns.name: roads
fns.doc: Every road def.

fns.name: base_gen
fns.doc: Runs a base generation symbol (basePart_outdoors, ancientRuins, settlement, ...) on a rectangle.

fns.name: list
fns.doc: Every scenario def.

fns.name: current
fns.doc: The scenario of the running game with its parts.

fns.name: part_defs
fns.doc: Every scenario part def.

fns.name: disallowed_buildings
fns.doc: Buildings the game rules forbid.

fns.name: set_building_allowed
fns.doc: Allows or forbids a building in the game rules.

fns.name: info
fns.doc: Growth, stage, yield and rate of a plant.

fns.name: set_growth
fns.doc: Sets growth from 0 to 1.

fns.name: harvest
fns.doc: Harvests a plant at once and drops its yield. Returns the amount.

fns.name: can_grow
fns.doc: Whether a plant can grow on a cell, and what blocks it.

fns.name: sow
fns.doc: Plants a plant at once.

fns.name: fertility
fns.doc: Soil fertility of a cell.

fns.name: zones
fns.doc: Growing zones.

fns.name: set_zone_plant
fns.doc: Changes what a growing zone grows.

fns.name: defs
fns.doc: Every plant def.

fns.name: list
fns.doc: Active game conditions on a map, or on the world when no map is loaded.

fns.name: defs
fns.doc: Every game condition def.

fns.name: start
fns.doc: Starts a game condition such as ColdSnap or HeatWave.

fns.name: stop
fns.doc: Ends a game condition. Returns how many were ended.

fns.name: temperature_offset
fns.doc: Total temperature offset from active conditions.

fns.name: defs
fns.doc: Every weather def.

fns.name: sky
fns.doc: Light, wind, weather transition and temperature of a map.

fns.name: season
fns.doc: Season and how far into the year the map is.

fns.name: get
fns.doc: Raw string stored by a mod. Scope is game, map or world. Prefer fetch.

fns.name: set
fns.doc: Stores a raw string in the save. Prefer put.

fns.name: remove
fns.doc: Removes a stored value.

fns.name: keys
fns.doc: The keys a mod stored in a scope.

fns.name: version
fns.doc: The data version a mod last wrote into this save, 0 when none.

fns.name: set_version

fns.name: game_version
